text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0832 CDT.

CANOLA - C$2.00 to C$2.50 a tonne higher on hot, dry Prairie weather and CBOT soycomplex calls. Technical resistance seen in the November at C$346 but if buying exceeds that level it may entice fund buying. Crusher short covering was expected in the August. November WCE canola crush profit margins rose to -5.38 Monday from -6.95 Friday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3847, fell to 84.91 yen and slipped to 1.3229 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on spill over support.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne higher on CBOT corn calls and possible commission short covering.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.30 to C$0.80 up on CBOT wheat and corn calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
